prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist, but **Dr. Shirley Zhao’s office (Zhao DDS)** looks like a promising option for a routine checkup and cleaning: its site reports **4.8/5 from 100+ reviews**, and lists routine exams and cleanings among its services.

**Zhao DDS**  
1400 Santa Rita Road, Suite L, Pleasanton  
(925) 462-7117  
[Website](https://pleasanton-dentist.com/)

Another option is **Alisal Dental Care**, which has patient comments specifically praising its cleanings: 5933 Coronado Lane, Suite 205; (925) 846-6308.

Before booking, confirm they accept your insurance and ask whether the quoted visit includes the exam, cleaning, and any X-rays. If you have gum disease, the dentist may recommend a different type of cleaning, which can affect the cost.
